what.text: This page follows refugees from Croatia living in Serbia and Kosovo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 16510 Croatian refugees there, 95.9% of all refugees from Croatia.
Almost all refugees from Croatia live in Serbia and Kosovo; small numbers live in Germany, Norway and the Netherlands.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Serb territory in Croatia from 1992 to 1995, with the Serbian Republic of Krajina and Serbian irregulars, at war level in some of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 and 1995 to 2004.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 166910 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 298534, at the end of 1999, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Serbia and Kosovo.
UNHCR reports Serbia and Kosovo as one host; these are year-end totals reported to UNHCR.
